segments.title: 第45章 班長的職責
segments.content:
Chapter 45: The Class President's Duties

Eleven-thirty in the morning.

After lunch, Kong Junxiang returned to his office. Bored, he opened his computer to read a novel.

Today was the first day of school. The students were scheduled for physical check-ups in the afternoon, and the head teachers also had a meeting to attend. So, he was snatching a moment of leisure amidst his busy schedule to entertain himself for a bit.

But after just over half an hour of reading, there was a knock on the office door.

"Teacher Kong." Li Luo's voice came from the doorway.

Kong Junxiang quickly switched his screen, not letting Li Luo see the familiar book title on it.

"What is it?"

"You mentioned we have physical check-ups this afternoon. What are the specific arrangements?" Li Luo had just finished lunch. After walking Ying Chanxi back to the classroom, he dropped by upstairs.

"Oh, that." Kong Junxiang picked up his teacup, but just as he was about to take a sip, he looked down and saw it was empty. He set the cup down. "There was no rush, I was supposed to come down and find you all later. But since you're here, I'll tell you first."

Hearing this, Li Luo had already walked over to the desk, proactively reached for Kong Junxiang's teacup, and headed toward the water dispenser. "I'll get you some water. Do you want it hot?"

"Oh, thank you." Kong Junxiang was momentarily stunned, then said, "Hot, with a little cold water mixed in."

After Li Luo handed the teacup back, Kong Junxiang gave him a longer look before finally lowering his head to take a sip of tea and continuing:

"The physical check-ups are at the gymnasium. They'll start with Class One. Based on the schedule, it will probably be our turn around two or three in the afternoon. We'll wait for the official notification for the exact time."

"When it's our class's turn, have the sports representative lead the students over. I'll go along as well. After the check-ups are done, you can help me collect all the physical examination forms."

"Then, compile the heights of all the students in class and go to the warehouse by the sports field to pick up the military training uniforms."

Li Luo nodded in understanding. "Is there anything else after that?"

"During evening self-study, you all have a meeting to attend." Kong Junxiang thought for a moment, then said, "The four of you should all go."

"It's about the military training tomorrow, right?"

"Yes." Kong Junxiang smiled. "Just some points of notice and things like that."

"Okay." Li Luo nodded. "If there's nothing else, I'll head back now?"

"Go on." Kong Junxiang's hand moved to the mouse, planning to continue reading his novel after Li Luo left.

But just as he reached the door, Li Luo suddenly turned back and said to Kong Junxiang, "Teacher Kong, Windows key plus D quickly switches to the desktop. It's quite useful."

With that, Li Luo walked out of the office, thoughtfully closing the door behind him.

Sitting in his chair, Kong Junxiang froze for a second, then looked down and tried it. He found that it really did switch directly to the desktop.

The next second, Kong Junxiang realized what had happened and shook his head, not knowing whether to laugh or cry. "This kid..."

...

Returning from the fifth floor to the third, Li Luo glanced at the students in the classroom, then walked over to the desks of Hua Xiuxiu, Zhu Yufei, and Yan Zhusheng, calling the three of them out into the hallway.

After relaying what Teacher Kong had just told him, Li Luo looked at Hua Xiuxiu. "Later, when all the students have arrived, you go up to the front and announce the plans for the rest of the day. Then go to the teacher's office to get the physical examination forms."

"Aren't you going to announce it yourself?" Hua Xiuxiu looked at Li Luo, still a little resentful about the class president position, and retorted subconsciously.

"If the class president does everything personally, then what's the point of having a vice class president?" Li Luo gave Hua Xiuxiu a strange look. "When you were class president before, you never gave the vice president anything to do?"

Hua Xiuxiu: "..."

To be fair, when Hua Xiuxiu was class president in elementary and junior high school, that was indeed how she always did things.

Only for tasks that absolutely required two people would Hua Xiuxiu call on her usually dispensable vice class president.

But in Li Luo's memory, Ying Chanxi had always been a hands-off class president. Much of the time, the vice class president was the one doing the work. She only needed to listen to the teacher's instructions and then pass them on to the vice president and other class committee members.

Back in junior high, Shao Heqi had been eager to do these things, doing them with the utmost willingness.

"In any case, I'll have to trouble you with this," Li Luo said with a smile.

Having been given her task, Hua Xiuxiu returned to the classroom with a gloomy expression.

She hadn't managed to get the class president position, but it seemed the amount of work she had to do hadn't decreased.

However, once all the students had arrived in the classroom, Hua Xiuxiu took a deep breath, went up to the podium, and told her classmates about the arrangements for the rest of the day.

Li Luo sat in his seat by the window in the back row. Yan Zhusheng, who was next to him, turned her head to look at him and suddenly asked, "Why did you choose two sports representatives? We only ever had one in junior high."

"Having a female sports representative would make certain things more convenient," Li Luo said. "Some girls are shy and have low self-esteem, and they're too embarrassed to say when they're on their period. If they try to tough it out during military training, it would be bad if they run into health problems."

"With you around, girls in that situation would at least dare to explain their situation to you and ask for leave to rest sooner."

"Besides, in high school P.E. classes, boys and girls might have separate sessions, which would also require a female sports representative."

"Oh, okay." Yan Zhusheng nodded, accepting Li Luo's explanation.

Seeing her fall quiet again, Li Luo felt a little emotional.

He felt that in high school, Yan Zhusheng's personality wasn't that different from how she was more than ten years later.

Still simple and innocent, straightforward and serene.

But Li Luo also knew very well that this was just one side of Yan Zhusheng in her normal state.

...

In the afternoon, Hua Xiuxiu went to the teacher's office to get the physical examination forms and distributed them to everyone.

Around two o'clock, Kong Junxiang also came down from his office. After the P.E. teacher in charge of the check-ups came to notify them, he called for the students to line up in the hallway and head out.

By this time, Class One and Class Two had already finished their check-ups and were trickling back upstairs.

As she passed the third floor, Ying Chanxi glanced in the direction of Class Eight and saw Li Luo walking out of the classroom side-by-side with a very beautiful girl.

Her footsteps came to an abrupt halt.

"What's wrong, Xixi?" Her deskmate, Qiao Xinyan, looked at her strangely. "We're not at the fourth floor yet."

"Oh... it's nothing." Ying Chanxi retracted her gaze and pursed her lips, ultimately following her deskmate back to the classroom.

On the other side, Li Luo didn't notice Ying Chanxi's figure. Holding his physical examination form, he followed the line toward the gymnasium.

All in all, it took over an hour to get through the lines and finish the physical check-ups.

He then found Hua Xiuxiu in the line for one of the stations and asked, "How many stations do you have left?"

"This is the last one," Hua Xiuxiu said. "What's up?"

"Then after you're done, remember to collect the physical examination forms and give them to me when you get back to the classroom," Li Luo instructed.

Hua Xiuxiu bit her lip. "...Okay."
